## A slide with notes

- The audience sees this
- [And this, after a click]{.fragment}

::: {.fragment}
Fragments are all shown in the thumbnail.

::: {.notes}
**Start here.** The notes can hold anything Markdown can:

a) a lettered list,
b) *emphasis*, `code` and maths, like $E[X] = \sum_i x_i\, p_i$,

- and bullets.

$$ P(\ge 1 \text{ six}) = 1 - (5/6)^4 = 0.518 $$
:::
